title: Nice lunch box
text: Nice lunch box. Even though this is considered a lunch box I use it as a small cooler when I go grocery shopping and only have a few Items to put in there. It keeps things cold for a long time.

product_metadata.title: RealCool Insulated Lunch Bag for Women/Men, Lunch Box, Lunch Tote Bag, Leakproof Lunch Cooler with Buckle, Removable Shoulder Strap, for Work/Office/Picnic - (8L)
features: 【Keep Food Fresh and Warm】The exterior of the cooler bag is constructed from high density water-resistant dirt-proof Oxford fabric. The inner layers are made of thicker, reinforced BPA free,food-grade PEVA materials with seamless ultrasonic welding for 100% leakproof and tear resistance.A built-in 5mm EPE foam middle layer and 210D liner add additional insulation, allowing the Realcool lunch bag to keep food cold/warm for 8-10hours.

【Multi Compartments】It has 1 main zipped compartment for lunch, bread,yogurt etc, 1 front zippered pocket for your keys, cards, phone or other small stuffs, 1 back velcro pocket for plates and napkins, 2 mesh pockets for cold water and your hot coffee, 1 internal mesh pocket for utensils, snacks. Size:10.6"L x 6.3"W x 7.9"H.Enough to store 12 cans of cola (330 ml).Easily folds to save storage space. Neither too big nor too small just the right size and space.

【Leakproof & SAB Double Zip】These insulated lunch bag is made of ultra-thick soft lining and hot-welded seams, no worries about ice cubes melting or sauce leaking any more. Waterproof Oxford cloth protects your lunch and food inside from occasional splatters or light rain. The portable lunch box features high quality metal SBS double zip to ensure easy slide.

【 Easy to Carry】The reusable lunch box is designed with a detachable & adjustable padded soft shoulder strap that can be adjusted from 15" to 27". Portable and lightweight with handle, convenient to carry and hold. you can easily enjoy using our work lunch bag as a modern fashion handbag, great shoulder bag or a cool crossbody bag. Specially designed buckle at the handle allows it to be attached to other bags.

【Versatile Bag】It can be also used as a cooler bag, a hand tote or a camping bag or simply use it as a grab-and-go bag to work or shopping. Small and portable, Great for offices. Also suitable for outdoor activities such as fishing, hiking, picnics, etc. Suit for all groups, including office workers, women, men and adults. It is also a great gift idea. If you are not 100% satisfied with our lunch bag, please contact us and we will solve any problem for you!
